_source: MLB leverage index / win expectancy tables (public). Focus on late-inning events.
_unit: win probability delta for the home team, signed.

SCORING_PLAY:late_close.note: Home run or walk-off RBI in innings 7+ when margin <= 2 runs.

SCORING_PLAY:late.note: Scoring play in innings 7+ when margin 3-4 runs.

SCORING_PLAY.note: Scoring play in innings 1-6 or blowout.

PITCHING_CHANGE.note: Late-inning pitching change. Direction depends on matchup quality — not modeled yet.
